articles.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
articles.snippet: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

articles.title: Lighter recovers $5M after $10M exploit linked to compromised API keys
articles.snippet: Lighter restored withdrawals after recovering approximately $5 million in USDC, while blockchain analysts traced $10.4 million in funds moved during the exploit.

articles.title: HKMA, Swift explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments
articles.snippet: HKMA and Swift will explore linking Project Ensemble with Swift’s ledger for cross-border payments using tokenized deposits in multiple currencies.
